answer: A durable costly signal beats cheap identities. Each agent posts a refundable stake that unlocks only as independent peers attest to real work across many epochs, so standing seeps in slowly like pigment soaking into stone rather than being bought outright. A clone fleet must fund fresh collateral per fake and wait its own vesting window to reach the zenith of trust, so sybil cost scales linearly with headcount instead of letting one bond mint a thousand voices.
